headline: TVK’s Biggest Promise Costs ₹24,600 Crore a Year. The Budget Has No Room Yet.
title: Seven-slide data carousel: what Rs 2,500 a month for women costs Tamil Nadu, GST, three scenario paths, other states, the Titan stake, and idly's verdict.
caption:
TVK's biggest promise, ₹2,500 a month for 1.31 crore women, costs about ₹24,600 crore more every year. The state is already borrowing at the 3% cap.

Our reading: the budget already strains the borrowing cap, and ₹2,500 widens the gap. The government says the scheme's details are being finalised; its Finance Secretary said "within a year" on 5 August. We built three paths to 2028-29 on the government's own plan; these are idly's scenarios, not a forecast. All three cross the cap before spending cuts. Gross GST grew 3% in October while neighbouring states grew 18 to 24%; the GST the state keeps is up 15% this year by the same official figures.

The state's 27.88% of Titan is worth about ₹1.24 lakh crore. Selling it would pay for five years, once. We found no proposal to sell it.

What would ₹2,500 a month change in your household?

Sources: Tamil Nadu budget 2026-27 and fiscal plan, PRS, 16th Finance Commission, GST Network, The Tribune, Business Standard, ThePrint, DT Next.
